dedupe_keys.name: integrated resource planning and optimization irpopt

description: Integrated Resource Planning and Optimization (IRPopt) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by "Institute for Infrastructure and Resources Management (IIRM); University Leipzig; Institute for Applied Informatics (InfAI); Leipzig". Integrated modeling of multi-modal decision systems for municipal energy utilities. Major aim is to provide managerial guidance in the process of strategy planning by simulating the impact of business models on differing municipal system conditions. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Time resolution: annual, hour, 15 min. Spatial resolution: regions, NUTS 3, municipalities, districts. Software: GAMS. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
